# mcp/tests/fixtures/old_coherence_record_l39.json

## Governing Overview

[Test route overview](../overview.md)

## Purpose

Retain the complete pre-capacity-derivation L39 curator-coherence record as a declared compatibility derivative, not an exact original-byte recording.

## Boundaries

The fixture preserves the original record encoding, typed leaf identity and dependency declaration, with exactly eight original-machine home-prefix occurrences translated to `/home/test`. The external exact-byte catalog pin remains historical and no longer matches the derivative; the declaration lives in `test_old_coherence_record_still_loads`. It is consumed by the production-model backward-loading test; it is not the current coherence authority for any live leaf and must not be substituted for unavailable historical evidence.

## Evidence

- Complete historical encoding is retained as an eight-path translated compatibility derivative, not original bytes. [1]

- The production record model parses this exact fixture. [2]
